subject: general
question: a trader loses 12% by selling an article at Rs 211.20. If sold at Rs.248.40, then his loss/profit percentage
solution:
given by:

SP of diameter = Rs. 211.2

Loss % = 12

Concept used:

SP = CP - CP × Damage%

Profit % = (Profit/CP) × 100

Here,

SP = Selling Price

CP = Price

Calculation:

Let CP be 100a

According to the question,

100a - 100a × 12% = 211.2

⇒ 100a - 12a = 211.2

⇒ 88a = 211.2

⇒ a = 211.2/88

⇒ a = 2.4

So, CP = 100 × 2.4 = Rs. 240

Now, new SP = Rs. 248.4

So, gain = 248.4 - 240

⇒ Rs. 8.4

Profit % = (8.4/240) × 100

⇒ 3.5

So, profit on sale is 3.5%

∴ His profit percentage is 3.5%.

⇒ 1 = 88%/211.20

**∴ Rs. 248.40 = (88%/211.20) × 248.40 = 3.5%**
